authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.sourceDependencies: W14-W15 accepted as applicable plus upstream read models/evidence
defaults.mission: Schema-driven workspace and desktop/web control surfaces for progress, approvals, evidence, budgets, latency/cost and routing/cache/template summaries; UI is never authority and never exposes private chain-of-thought.
sources: - MCP human control center / legacy dashboard references as UX-only input

tasks.title: W16-00 - Workspace Coordination & Surface Freeze
actions: 1. Revalidate W14/W15 and upstream read/evidence contracts.
2. Freeze workspace views, command/control boundaries and ownership.
3. Define which UI actions create requests vs display state; UI must never mint authority.
4. Define schema-driven component strategy and desktop/web packaging.
5. Create risk/premortem for stale UI, misleading approval state, tenant leakage and private reasoning exposure.
tasks.forbidden: Do not implement new policy/executor/business logic in UI.

tasks.title: W16-A - Workspace / Web / Desktop Foundation
actions: 1. Implement application shell, authentication/session consumption and navigation.
2. Use schema-driven domain views rather than hardcoded duplicate business state.
3. Support responsive tablet/desktop/web operation as planned.
4. Handle reconnect/degraded state visibly.
5. Add session/tenant/view isolation tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not duplicate backend state machines.

tasks.title: W16-B - Schema-Driven Views & Read Models
actions: 1. Render objectives/tasks/capabilities/receipts/evidence from accepted schemas/read models.
2. Respect tenant/data classification and field visibility.
3. Show freshness/provenance where relevant.
4. Represent unknown/stale/conflicting state explicitly.
5. Add schema compatibility tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not infer authority or hidden state from missing fields.

tasks.title: W16-C - Job / DAG / Lane Progress & Cancellation UX
actions: 1. Consume W14 progress/job/DAG/lane streams.
2. Display bounded progress and cancellation states.
3. Make cancel request idempotent and show pending/late-completion races correctly.
4. Handle reconnect/replay without duplicated UI commands.
5. Add UX state-machine tests.
tasks.forbidden: UI cancellation is a request; it does not directly mutate executor internals.

tasks.title: W16-D - Approval & Evidence / Human Control Surfaces
actions: 1. Display current approval/authority-related state from canonical backend sources.
2. Create explicit user decision requests through authorized backend APIs.
3. Display evidence/readback and correlation for audit.
4. Prevent UI from fabricating approval or trusting stale screen state.
5. Add stale/revoked approval and race tests.

tasks.title: W16-E - Budget, Latency, Cost, Cache/Template/Route Summaries
actions: 1. Display ExecutionBudget use, latency/cost, route/reasoning summary, cache/template hits and confidence summary.
2. Make clear these are observability/intelligence signals, not permission.
3. Show degraded/fallback conditions and provenance.
4. Avoid private chain-of-thought exposure.
5. Add privacy/redaction tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not expose hidden CoT or secrets.

tasks.title: W16-F - Desktop/Web UX, Offline & Degraded Modes
actions: 1. Implement desktop/web packaging and supported offline/degraded read behavior.
2. Queue only safe UI requests according to backend contracts.
3. Communicate stale/offline status and prevent unsafe action replay.
4. Support accessibility and keyboard/navigation where relevant.
5. Add reconnect/offline tests.
tasks.forbidden: Do not locally authorize actions while offline.

tasks.title: W16-G - Workspace Integration, Auditability & Acceptance
actions: 1. Run UI E2E for progress, cancellation, approvals, evidence, stale state and reconnect.
2. Verify tenant isolation, no CoT/secret leakage and authority separation.
3. Run four Risk Gates/performance budget and exact-head CI.
4. Prove UI explains execution sufficiently for audit without becoming source of truth.
5. Publish W16 acceptance/handoff to W17.
